faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.desc: Everything you need to know about our programs and services.
faq.a1: We offer English, French, and German language training, structured according to the Common European Framework of Reference (CEFR) from A1 to B2.
faq.q2: What is the CEFR and how does it apply to your courses?
faq.a2: The CEFR (Common European Framework of Reference) is an international standard for language proficiency. Our courses are aligned to CEFR levels A1 (beginner) through B2 (upper-intermediate), ensuring globally recognized progression.
faq.a3: Each CEFR level (A1, A2, B1, B2) is divided into 3 packs. Pack 1 includes a material fee. Packs 2 and 3 cover tuition only. You can progress at your own pace.
faq.q4: What are the class formats available?
faq.a4: We offer Intensive (5 sessions/week, 10 hours/week) and Semi-Intensive (3 sessions/week, 6 hours/week) formats, both online and in-person.
faq.q5: Do I get a certificate after completing a level?
faq.a5: Yes! Learners receive a certificate upon successful completion of each CEFR level. We also prepare students for international exams like TEF, TCF, DELF, DALF, and Goethe-Zertifikat.
faq.q6: How long does it take to complete one level?
faq.a6: Each pack takes approximately 4–6 weeks depending on the format chosen. A full level (3 packs) typically takes 12–18 weeks.
faq.q7: Do you offer exam preparation courses?
faq.a7: Yes. We offer intensive exam preparation for TEF, TCF, DELF, DALF, and Goethe-Zertifikat. The program covers 40 hours over 7 weeks with 3 sessions per week. Contact languageservices@edulearningimmersion.org for details.
faq.q8: Which international exams can I prepare for?
faq.a8: We prepare students for TEF (Test d'Évaluation de Français), TCF (Test de Connaissance du Français), DELF/DALF (Diplôme d'Études en Langue Française), and Goethe-Zertifikat for German.
faq.q9: Are exams included in the course fee?
faq.a9: Exam preparation is a separate program from general language courses. Exam registration fees are paid directly to the examining body and are not included in our tuition.
faq.q10: What translation services do you offer?
faq.a10: We offer document translation (legal, medical, technical, business), certified translation, website localization, and multilingual desktop publishing across multiple language pairs.
faq.q11: What types of interpretation do you provide?
faq.a11: We provide Simultaneous Interpretation (₦112,500/hr), Consecutive Interpretation (₦75,000/hr), Liaison Interpretation (₦67,500/hr), and Remote Interpretation (₦60,000/hr). Urgent rates and full-day discounts (15%) are available.
faq.q12: Do you offer proofreading and editing services?
faq.a12: Yes. We offer Basic Proofreading (from ₦4,000/page), Professional Editing (from ₦6,000/page), and Premium Rewriting (from ₦10,000/page). Express delivery surcharges apply for urgent work.
faq.q13: How do I request a quote for translation or interpretation?
faq.a13: Visit our Translation & Interpretation page and fill out the quote request form with your document details, language pair, and deadline. We respond within 24 hours.
faq.q14: Do you offer language programs for schools?
faq.a14: Yes. We partner with primary and secondary schools to deliver structured English, French, and German programs tailored to the school curriculum and schedule.
faq.a15: Absolutely. We offer professional development workshops and training programs for language teachers, focusing on CEFR methodology and modern teaching techniques.
faq.q16: Do you provide after-school language clubs?
faq.a16: Yes. We can set up after-school language clubs and extracurricular programs for students, including conversation practice, cultural activities, and exam preparation.
faq.a17: We work with school administrators to assess needs, design a tailored program, deploy qualified instructors, and provide regular progress reports. Contact us for a school partnership proposal.
faq.a18: Yes. Our immersion programs provide intensive language and cultural experiences. Contact us for upcoming immersion schedules and destinations.
faq.q19: What does an immersion program include?
faq.a19: Immersion programs include intensive daily classes, cultural activities, real-world practice sessions, and guided excursions — all designed for rapid language acquisition.
faq.q20: Who can join an immersion program?
faq.a20: Immersion programs are open to individuals of all levels (A1–B2). Corporate groups and school delegations can also arrange custom immersion experiences.
faq.q21: Do you offer digital marketing services?
faq.a21: Yes. We provide digital communication solutions including social media strategy, content creation, multilingual digital marketing, and brand communication consulting.
faq.q22: Can you help with multilingual content creation?
faq.a22: Absolutely. We create professional multilingual content for websites, social media, marketing campaigns, and corporate communications in English, French, and other languages.
faq.q23: How can my organization partner with Edu learning & Immersion?
faq.a23: We welcome partnerships with academic institutions, corporate organizations, NGOs, government agencies, and international bodies. Visit our Partnerships page or contact us directly.
faq.q24: Do you work with NGOs and international organizations?
faq.a24: Yes. We support multilingual communication for humanitarian, development, and diplomatic projects through language training, translation, and interpretation services.
faq.q25: Can language teachers join your platform?
faq.a25: Yes. We welcome qualified teachers of English, French, German, Dutch, Spanish, Chinese, and other languages to teach under the Edu learning & Immersion platform. Contact us to apply.
faq.a26: Yes. We offer free consultations for corporate training, school partnerships, and large-scale translation projects. Use our contact form or WhatsApp to schedule one.
faq.q27: How do I contact Edu learning & Immersion?
faq.a27: Email us at contact@edulearningimmersion.org, WhatsApp us at +234 916 078 4634, or use the contact form on our website. We typically respond within minutes on WhatsApp.
faq.q28: Where is Edu learning & Immersion located?
faq.a28: We are headquartered in Cameroon with services delivered globally through online platforms and in-person programs in select locations.
faq.q29: Are courses available for complete beginners?
faq.a29: Yes. Our A1 level is designed specifically for complete beginners with no prior knowledge of the language.
faq.q30: Can I switch between online and in-person formats?
faq.a30: Yes. Learners can switch between online and in-person formats between packs, subject to availability.
faq.a31: Yes. We offer special pricing for groups, corporate teams, and institutional partnerships. Contact us for a custom quote.
faq.q32: What payment methods do you accept?
faq.a32: We accept bank transfers, mobile payments, and card payments. Payment plans are available for multi-pack enrollments.
